concerns.text: FR-014 ('MUST ingest a verified SORCE/TIM satellite TSI dataset... sole training target') and FR-013/SC-001 (2007 baseline, rmse_reduction_percentage) are MUST-level requirements with NO backing plan element — Phase 3 is explicitly conditional and skipped today. The plan flags this honestly, but the spec remains contradictory: it mandates data that no verified source provides. Spec must be revised (make TSI/baseline conditional or re-source) before the plan can claim full coverage.

concerns.location: spec.md:FR-002 vs plan.md Phase 2 / Data Availability
concerns.text: FR-002 defines the low-activity proxy as 'a fixed value representing the average total solar irradiance observed during the 2008–2019 minimum, expressed in W/m²'. The plan instead fills gaps with 'mean GSN over the 2008–2019 minimum' — a sunspot-number unit, not a W/m² TSI value. This is a spec/plan mismatch on a MUST requirement; either the spec's proxy definition or the plan's implementation must be reconciled.

SC-002 (R² against observed satellite TSI) is only 'conditional' in the plan; as written the spec makes it a measurable outcome with no fallback measurement. Same root cause as FR-014, but the spec should state the degraded-path success criterion explicitly rather than the plan silently nulling it.

concerns.location: constitution.md Principle VI vs plan.md Phase 3
concerns.text: Constitution VI mandates validation on held-out satellite-era data 2016–present (training 2003–2015). The plan uses leave-one-cycle-out CV only and never mentions the 2016–present holdout split. The plan documents the Principle VII Hilbert-Huang deviation but is silent on this Principle VI validation-split requirement — an unbacked constitutional MUST.

concerns.location: spec.md Edge case 3 vs plan.md Phase 2
concerns.text: Spec edge case requires a documented calibration/gap-filling correction for SORCE/TIM instrument drift with sensitivity analysis on the correction method. The plan's conditional TSI path mentions only 'attempted; flagged unavailable' and no drift-correction step even for the future TSI-available branch. Add it to the conditional Phase 1/3 path or note the spec gap.
